# Power BI check values

*Generated by `scripts/powerbi_checks.py` from the Parquet files in `powerbi/data/`.
Do not edit by hand.*

Once the measures are in the model, run the `EVALUATE` queries at the end of
[`measures.dax`](measures.dax) in DAX query view (or build the visuals described),
and compare. The query results also show their sort columns (`sort_order`,
`month_key`). Rates are shown to two decimal places; Power BI's numbers should
match to the last digit shown. Each value here is computed from the Parquet
files with the same logic as the DAX, and a test checks it against the dbt
metrics models, so a match means the Power BI model agrees with the warehouse.

### 1. National by period

Measures: Period Flights Scheduled, Period On-time Arrival %, Period On-time Departure %, Period Cancellation %. As a visual: a table with `period_label` (sorted by `sort_order`).

| period_label | flights | on-time arrivals | on-time departures | cancelled |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FY2004-05 to FY2018-19 | 7,908,968.50 | 82.24% | 83.60% | 1.50% |
| FY2018-19 | 563,834 | 79.36% | 80.60% | 2.05% |
| Oct 2025 to Sep 2026 | 546,792 | 77.87% | 78.67% | 1.92% |

### 2. Rolling 12 months

### 6. The missing-cancellations trap, FY2006-07 routes

Measure: Route Cancellation %, filtered to `financial_year_label` = FY2006-07. The last column is what a plain DIVIDE(SUM(cancellations), SUM(sectors_scheduled)) gives: it counts the flights with no cancellation figure as if none were cancelled.

| brand_family | rows missing cancellations | cancelled | cancelled if blanks count as zero |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jetstar | 141 | 0.57% | 0.46% |
| Qantas | 78 | 1.20% | 1.10% |
| QantasLink | 97 | 0.48% | 0.35% |

### 7. Totals and the volume floor

Measures: Flights Scheduled and Route Flights Scheduled with no filters (the national total is the sum of the airline networks, a little above BITRE's published national row; see `audit_national_total` in the warehouse), then a count of city pairs where Period Route Meets Floor is true in the latest period.

| column | value |
|---|---|
| national flights, all months | 11,499,305.50 |
| listed-route flights, all months | 8,681,901 |
| city pairs above the floor, latest 12 months | 40 |
